verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical, and both have the same problems. The 'Golden-hour botanicals' tagline is tiny and stranded in the lower left, away from the 'Glow' headline it should support. The product jar is shrunk to a small, under-weighted shape on the far left, and the elements are spread across the banner with no shared baseline or grid. A's 'Shop Now' button sits almost against the right canvas edge. B has a little more right margin and keeps the tagline slightly closer to the content, so it is marginally less cramped.
